title: Area of Interest (AOI): Enterprise Scheduling Tool Replacement for Project Online Retirement under CSO N0003925S0001
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.SPAWAR.SPAWAR HQ.NAVAL INFORMATION WARFARE SYSTEMS
detail_text: This is an Area of Interest (AOI) seeks innovative commercial solutions for project management and scheduling. This AOI is issued under NAVWAR CSO N0003925S0001, posted to SAM.gov. This AOI solicits white papers/solution briefs from industry to inform market research, capability assessment, and potential follow-on prototyping or acquisition. This is not a formal solicitation or request for proposals. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with submission or participation. The Government reserves the right to cancel, modify, or not pursue any efforts under this AOI.
